children: CRH launched cash tender and exchange offers for Arcosa notes, including exchanges for up to $1 billion of new guaranteed notes.
CRH will offer to purchase any and all of Arcosa’s $400 million of 2029 notes and $600 million of 2032 notes.
Eligible holders can exchange Arcosa notes for new CRH notes with matching maturities and interest rates, subject to offer terms.
Early tender consideration is $983.75 per $1,000 of 2029 notes and $1,035 per $1,000 of 2032 notes, plus accrued interest.
Arcosa is seeking consents for amendments that would remove certain indenture covenants, restrictive provisions, defaults and guarantees.
The offers expire December 4, 2026; the early tender deadline is November 18, and early tender purchases are expected to settle November 20.
